breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly resolved the inconsistency by removing the contradictory instruction to 'evaluate the Euler load from π^2 E I / L^2'. The generated specification only includes the correct formula, P_cr = π^2 E I / (K L)^2, which aligns with the ground truth.
